  PROBLEM: `check_review_runs()` trusts a workflow dispatch’s `[pr:<N>]` display-title suffix without verifying that the run executed from the trusted default branch.
  WHY: Dispatches can use PR-controlled branches whose workflow YAML can forge run titles; a forged successful run can be accepted as the newest review for another PR and allow auto-merge despite a failed review.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:533-534 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Failed untitled dispatches from any branch are added to `untitled_failures` without checking whether the run is trusted or relevant to the PR.
  WHY: The workflow-dispatch listings are global, so an unrelated failed run can return `review_superseded` for PRs whose markers predate it and block their pending-checks auto-merge.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:533-534, 548-552 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: An untitled failed dispatch remains a blocker even when a newer bound review for the PR completed successfully.
  WHY: After selecting the newer successful review, `check_review_runs()` still returns `review_superseded` whenever `untitled_failures` is non-empty.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:452 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `check_review_runs()` has no `default_branch` parameter, preventing callers from applying the default-branch trust filter to dispatch runs.
  WHY: The missing parameter prevents the new dispatch-classification loop from filtering PR-branch runs using the trusted default branch.
